correctness.rationale: For E(A,B)=(A×Y)∪(X×B), a generating rectangle U×V lies in E iff U⊆A or V⊆B: otherwise choose one outside point in each coordinate. Upward closure gives the necessary membership in the corresponding factor filter; conversely pair a witnessing factor set with the whole opposite space. This works also for an empty side, for nonprincipal filters and for all A,B. Iterating from E(∅,∅) and computing the coordinate boxes on cylinders proves every closed γₙ. In the Kripke separator, take S the transitive strict order on n points with a disjoint loop, put R₁=R₂=S and R=S plus the arrow from the first chain point to the loop. The extra arrow has no incoming predecessor at its origin, and composes only with the loop on its right, so R is transitive. Both mixed composites lie in S⊆R, the sound direction for mix. A box power of falsity means absence of a path of exactly that length. No path from anywhere other than the root encounters the extra arrow; at the root lengths k<n have paths in all three relations, and at n only the synchronous relation has a path. With n=1 the chain is a singleton and the same witness refutes γ₁. All lower axioms are thus validated globally, so soundness proves strict nonderivability and the finite-subset consequence. originality.rationale: No inspected distinct result covers the conjunction of synchronous dead-end iteration for arbitrary normal full neighborhood products and depth-by-depth separation over three copies of K4 plus mix. The rectangle/filter infrastructure and mix schema are prior; the serial completeness theorem cannot supply the strict hierarchy, and exact reverse-mix/elimination results use different assumptions or address a different claim. Kudinov's earlier nonserial bimodal work is relevant; the readable 2023 summary shows the older completeness framework's closed formulas in a two-box language. The verdict is on the stated restricted hierarchy, not priority for product semantics, all variable-free principles, or nonfinite axiomatizability of a full product logic.
residual_risks: The two older originals were not fully inspected. Finer nonserial analogues or an added-modality discussion may exist without being captured by the readable synopsis.
This is bounded discovery and implication checking, not a proof of earliest publication or exhaustive absence of equivalent work.
